findings.message: Cell 2's last saved count is 2, while the visible X/y assignments in cell 1 have last saved count 3. A fresh kernel following only that recorded-count order would reach cell 2 before the visible producer. The notebook does not preserve enough history to conclude that this run failed: X and y could have existed in stale state, cell 1 could have run earlier and then been rerun at count 3, counts could reflect a restarted or mixed session, or outputs could have been stripped.
findings.suggestion: Restart the kernel and run cells in source order (or use Run All), then save outputs and counters from that clean run. Keep the data-producing cell before every consumer.
findings.title: The saved counters require runtime-state qualification

findings.message: StandardScaler.fit_transform(X) is called before train_test_split. If the split succeeds and X contains the examples later assigned to X_test, their distribution influences the scaler fitted for training, leaking holdout information into X_train.
findings.suggestion: Split the raw X and y first; fit the scaler on X_train only, then transform X_train and X_test separately with that fitted scaler.
findings.title: Scaling is fit before the holdout split

findings.message: The visible loop calls loss.backward() and optimizer.step() but not optimizer.zero_grad(). If the DataLoader yields at least two minibatches and cell 3 runs as shown, gradients from earlier minibatches remain and accumulate into later updates.
findings.suggestion: Call optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) before each loss.backward() unless deliberate gradient accumulation is intended and normalized/documented.
findings.title: The training loop never clears gradients

findings.message: Cell 2 creates X_test and y_test, but the only remaining cell builds a TensorDataset from X_train and y_train and performs training. No source cell computes holdout predictions, loss, or metrics, so the notebook cannot report generalization performance as written.
findings.suggestion: After training, switch to evaluation mode, disable gradient tracking, run the model on X_test, and report an appropriate loss and classification metrics.
findings.title: The holdout split is not evaluated in the inspected notebook
